observations: Photo 0 shows a large black solar panel (grid of cells) standing outdoors/near a building; no clear wattage label visible.
Photo 1 shows the same style/size solar panel from a different angle; brand text watermark on the image reads 'TINNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' but this is not a clear panel brand/model label.
No visible datasheet sticker, serial number, wattage rating, or manufacturer name on the panel surface in either photo.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours.
claims.evidence: The photos show only a solar panel; no battery is shown and no test/measurement is visible.
No battery/past repair evidence is shown; photos do not include any inspection marks or history.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium & Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: Seller text is broad; photos show a solar panel but do not confirm quality rating, inverter model, or battery type.

risks.risk: Panel wattage and exact model are not readable; price depends heavily on whether it’s 300W/350W/400W/600W etc.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker showing brand, model, wattage (W), Voc/Vmp, and serial number (or a datasheet photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case within the comparables: treat it as the lowest-wattage/lowest-spec option (not confirmed).

risks.risk: Condition is unclear (new vs used, any cracks, delamination, or cell damage).
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the panel corners/edges and the cell surface (including any hairline cracks) plus a photo of the backsheet/frame condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown condition (not confirmed new).

risks.risk: Performance/efficiency cannot be verified from photos (mono vs other, degradation, mismatch).
risks.proof: A power test reading (IV curve or multimeter/charger test under sun) or a documented test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not performance-verified (assume average/standard used performance).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the panel nameplate/datasheet sticker showing brand + model + wattage (W) + serial number (photo of the label).
Close-up photos of the panel corners/edges and any visible cracks/damage (front and back).
If claiming battery specs: photos of the exact battery model/type and a test result showing it holds charge for 8 hours.
response.reason: From the photos, the item is a solar panel but the wattage/model (which determines the correct market price) is not readable, and the seller’s battery claims are not supported by any battery photos or test evidence.
